Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Zach LaVine?

Zach LaVine is 31 years old.

Where was Zach LaVine born?

Zach LaVine was born in Renton, Washington.

When was Zach LaVine born?

Zach LaVine was born on March 10, 1995.

How tall is Zach LaVine?

Zach LaVine is 6-5 (196 cm) tall.

How much does Zach LaVine weigh?

Zach LaVine weighs 200 lbs (90 kg).

Is Zach LaVine in the Hall of Fame?

Zach LaVine is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Zach LaVine drafted?

Zach LaVine was drafted by Minnesota Timberwolves, 1st round (13th pick, 13th overall), 2014 NBA Draft.

What position does Zach LaVine play?

Shooting Guard, Small Forward, and Point Guard.

What is Zach LaVine's net worth?

Zach LaVine has made at least $256,839,617 playing professional basketball.

How much does Zach LaVine make?

Zach LaVine made $47,499,660 in 2026.

How many rings does Zach LaVine have?

Zach LaVine has won 0 championships.

What is Zach LaVine's Instagram account?

Zach LaVine is on Instagram at zachlavine8.

What schools did Zach LaVine attend?

Zach LaVine attended Bothell in Bothell, Washington and UCLA.

What are Zach LaVine's nicknames?

Young Hollywood, Flight 8 are nicknames for Zach LaVine.

Is Zach LaVine injured?

Zach LaVine is listed as Out For Season (Finger) - LaVine will undergo season-ending surgery on his right hand after the All-Star break, per Chris Haynes of NBA TV.
